Polusani, S., Vinayaka Ram, V. and Seshagiri Rao, M.V. (2025). Life Cycle Assessment of geopolymer concrete using Flyash and Slag for sustainable infrastructure. Innovative Infrastructure Solutions 10, 270. doi:10.1007/s41062-025-02084-w

Comparative cradle-to-gate LCA (SimaPro, ecoinvent, ReCiPe 2016 Midpoint H) of 1 m3 of two fly-ash/GGBS geopolymer concretes and M40 OPC concrete for pavements in India. Loaded: GWP per m3, printed % reductions, precursor and cement flows per m3. Non-GHG categories (ODP, toxicity, water, land) not loaded except fossil resource scarcity in other-values. Values are concrete-level per m3 and cannot be put per t binder from the paper (activator masses are given only as a 0.4 liquid/binder ratio). Locators are printed journal pages "Page N of 12" (= PDF page). TRAP: the abstract's "up to 45%" GWP reduction contradicts Table 5 (60.2-61.3%).
